name: Sharyn Westlake
story: LINZ’s 2017 geospatial virtual field trip identified Sharyn Westlake as a Senior Engineer in Flood Protection at Greater Wellington Regional Council and as a geospatial subject-matter expert for schools. Her inclusion records the use of spatial information in regional flood-protection engineering as well as the professional outreach around that work.
LINZ names Sharyn Westlake in its geospatial virtual field-trip record: Senior Engineer, Flood Protection, Greater Wellington Regional Council, 2017 VFT.
